hypotheses.claim: Recent V58 fills materially invalidate the frozen portfolio stop-wave sensitivity.
hypotheses.evidence: The exact 224-fill recalibration increased the modeled wave by $0.252973 and 0.005059 percentage points of $5,000.
hypotheses.falsifier: A later exact-fill recalibration produces a material portfolio delta or an observed correlated stop wave exceeds the sensitivity by a decision-relevant amount.

hypotheses.claim: Recent V58 ETH execution shows no change in the all-time slippage tail.
hypotheses.evidence: ETH entry p99 moved from 11.862016 to 13.372708 bps and adverse-exit p99 from 4.416277 to 8.408916 bps as each sample count increased from 14/13 to 17/17.
hypotheses.falsifier: A larger source-compatible ETH sample returns both tails to the prior range without hiding adverse fills.

hypotheses.claim: The SP500 friction collector covers the active fresh15-v3 provider identity.
hypotheses.evidence: Test-first falsifiers proved the legacy-only filter excluded an exact v3 protective-stop fill and that repeated snapshot wrapper times changed the row hash; the repaired collector includes published v1/v3 identities and hashes only stable fill fields.
hypotheses.falsifier: An exact published index-pressure identity or adverse operation remains excluded, or an unchanged fill set changes canonical identity after a later snapshot revision.
